name: Herringbone
author: E. T. Carter
description: A woven cloth of short oriented dashes that lean one way on one row and the other way on the next, building the classic herringbone chevron. Radial waves run diagonal bands of brightness across the weave.

params.label: Dash spacing
params.effect: Distance between dashes in CSS px - a dense tight weave at the minimum, an open sparse chevron at the maximum.

params.label: Dash length
params.effect: Resting length of each stitch. Short keeps a beaded weave; long stretches the dashes until they nearly link into continuous zigzag lines.

params.label: Dash thickness
params.effect: Thickness of each stitch. Fine draws hairline strokes; thick fattens them into bold woven bars.

params.label: Chevron lean
params.effect: Lean angle of the dashes, flipped row to row. 45 is the classic herringbone zigzag; low flattens toward horizontal stitching; high steepens the chevron.

params.label: Stretch
params.effect: How much a passing wavefront lengthens each stitch. 0 is a still weave; high stretches the dashes along the wave.

params.label: Wavelength
params.effect: Spacing of the concentric wave rings; short packs many bright bands across the weave, long sweeps one broad wave.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: Speed the wave travels out from the source; 0 freezes the weave mid-sweep.

params.label: Ripple count
params.effect: How many concentric wave rings span the field. Low is one broad slow band; high packs many tight bands of brightness.

params.label: Dash brightness
params.effect: Brightness of the dashes themselves. Low keeps the weave subtle, high makes the chevron pop in vivid colour.

params.label: Backlight
params.effect: Strength of the two soft drifting glow blobs behind the weave. 0 leaves crisp dashes on near-black; high adds a slow colour drift.

params.label: Crispness
params.effect: Edge hardness of the dashes. Low is soft glowing stitches; high snaps them to crisp high-contrast bars.

params.label: Origin X
params.effect: Horizontal position of the point the waves radiate from. 0 is centre; +/- drives the source toward an edge.

params.label: Origin Y
params.effect: Vertical position of the wave source. 0 is centre; +/- pushes it up or down.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole weave off the upright axis so the herringbone rows run diagonally.
